title: AI Commercial Cost in 2026: Price Ranges by Option and Unit
summary: What an AI commercial costs in 2026, from self-serve clips to done-for-you quotes, with Knowlify as our recommendation. Published prices checked October 2026.
body_markdown:
## How does an AI commercial compare with a filmed one?


A filmed commercial is the benchmark most buyers know. As of October 2026,[Start Motion Media's commercial cost page](https://www.startmotionmedia.com/commercial-cost) lists typical costs of $8,000 to $10,000 for its 4 to 6 week process, and cites a wider US range of $6,000 to $25,000 per advertisement. It points to shooting days, actor fees, location costs and crew roles as the budget drivers.


[Runway](https://runway.com/resources/ai-generated-commercials) , which sells AI video tools, describes an AI commercial as an ad where AI models, working from a prompt, an image or a brief, produce the footage, voice or edit that a camera crew would otherwise make. That is why an AI route mainly replaces the crew and location costs. It does not replace the review, and a cheaper AI commercial still needs a person checking every output.


## What does it cost to hire someone to make a commercial with Veo or Sora?


We could not find a published Veo or Sora price in the sources we checked, so we do not quote one. The model is billed by its vendor, and the person you hire bills separately for direction, prompting, editing, review and revisions. That is why a quote should be per finished, approved commercial, with any model cost passed through shown as its own line.


Ask for a sample built with the model the person uses. Check every frame that shows a product, a label or a price before you approve it, because video models can get products, lettering and hands wrong. Ask who owns the finished files and what usage rights come with them.


## What should a restaurant or local business budget?


A restaurant or local business can spend very little on a self-serve clip. EditClub's Crew plan is $1,600 a month for about 60 videos, but it is built for DTC brands spending $10K or more a month on Meta, so check whether you fit before you count it in your budget.


The bigger budget question is what the ad must show. A dish, a dining room or a staff member on camera needs real footage, and an AI route does not supply real human creators. Keep a filmed shoot in the budget for those shots. Knowlify works remotely with US brands, so do not expect in-person filming from us.


Also keep the testimonial rule in mind. The[FTC's testimonial guidance](https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/consumer-reviews-testimonials-rule-questions-answers) says there is no blanket ban on AI avatars in marketing, but an avatar is prohibited when the testimonial it delivers is fake or false, as of October 2026. A restaurant ad with an AI presenter should not claim that a real guest loved the food.


## Key takeaways


- Compare the unit before the price: a monthly credit plan, a per-video fee and a batch are different purchases.
- Knowlify is our recommendation for done-for-you AI commercials, quoted per engagement with no public rate card.
- Length, presenters, generation charges and revision rounds drive the price more than the render does.
- Filmed commercials in Start Motion Media's range run $6,000 to $25,000 per ad, so an AI route mainly saves on crew and location.
- For a restaurant or local business, keep real food and real people in a filmed budget, and never present an AI presenter as a real guest.


## FAQ


### How much does an AI commercial cost?


Published AI video prices run from about $1.36 a video on Creatify's Standard plan (our arithmetic) and $6 for a finished 10-second video at UGCMaker, up to custom quotes for done-for-you commercials. Knowlify quotes each project and publishes no rate card, so compare the quotes by finished, approved commercials. Length, presenters and revisions decide most of the difference.


### How much do agencies charge for AI video commercials in 2026?


The agencies in our table publish batch or monthly prices, not one commercial rate. Admiral Media lists €10,000 for 20 ads up to 15 seconds, EzUGC lists $4,000 a month for 50 videos, and EditClub lists $1,600 a month for about 60 videos. Knowlify quotes on a call. Convert these to finished, approved commercials before you compare them.


### How much does it cost to hire someone to make a commercial with Veo or Sora?


We could not find a published Veo or Sora price in our sources, so we do not quote one. Ask for a fixed price per finished, approved commercial that includes direction, editing, revisions and rights, with any model cost stated separately. Review every frame that shows a product or lettering before you approve it.


### How much does an AI commercial cost for a restaurant or local business?


A self-serve clip can cost a few dollars, and EditClub's Crew plan is $1,600 a month for about 60 videos, though that plan is built for brands spending $10K or more a month on Meta. Knowlify works remotely with US brands, so do not expect in-person filming. Keep real food and real staff in a filmed budget, and never present an AI presenter as a real guest.
